resources.string: Follow your computer from here. On your computer, open Moonfold, go to Settings, then Mobile App, and scan the code.

Moonfold is not answering. This screen reconnects by itself once Moonfold is running there and this phone can reach it: over the same Wi-Fi, Tailscale or a VPN, or anywhere when Reach from anywhere is on in its Mobile App settings.
The computer ended this phone\'s access. Scan a new code from Settings, then Mobile App, to connect again.
Codes work once and for a few minutes. Show a new one in Settings, then Mobile App, and scan it.
Check that this phone is on the same Wi-Fi as your computer, or on the same Tailscale or VPN network, or turn on Reach from anywhere in Moonfold\'s Mobile App settings. Then scan again.
This phone will show everything Moonfold shows at %1$s. Only continue if this is your computer.
Point the camera at the code in Settings, then Mobile App
That is not a Moonfold code
Moonfold needs the camera only to scan the pairing code.
No app here can open that link.
This phone has %1$s. The update comes from Moonfold\'s releases on GitHub, and your computer stays paired.
Moonfold will not check for updates. Long-press its icon and choose Check for updates to check again.
Could not check for updates. Try again when this phone is online.
The update did not download. Try again later.
The downloaded update was damaged, so it was not installed.
The update was not signed with Moonfold\'s key, so it was not installed.
Android did not install the update.
Android asks once before an app may install updates. Turn on Allow from this source for Moonfold, then come back here and the update continues.
